xBRIEFInfo.description: Cohort story #3259 (parallel to epic-3237 swarm; residual of #3080)

plan.title: fix(cursor): ephemeral local-dev ops must not require an active xBRIEF

narratives.Description: Cursor Multitask Task spawn still requires active xBRIEF for local-dev ops when only free-text worker_role is present. Ship D1 A+B: honest recovery/docs + session assist env (DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE assist set / DEFT_HOOK_ASSIST=1) as structural ephemeral markers for spawn tools only; implement conflict still wins. Reject prompt NLP (C) and unmarked generalPurpose fail-open (D).
narratives.Overview: fix(cursor): ephemeral local-dev ops must not require an active xBRIEF
narratives.UserStory: As a Cursor operator, I want to spawn ephemeral local-dev Task workers without an active xBRIEF when session assist posture is set, so that I can run docker compose and pnpm dev without inventing a fake lifecycle story.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Rewrite spawn-not-ready recovery: structural markers only; free-text [worker_role: ephemeral] not sufficient; Cursor prefer parent Shell or session assist. Update content/commands.md spawn postures. 2) Extend isEphemeralSpawn / shared helper so DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE assist-set and DEFT_HOOK_ASSIST=1 count as ephemeral for spawn tools only; implement conflict still denies. 3) Tests in packages/core/src/hooks. 4) CHANGELOG #3259. Out of scope: #3246, NLP markers, unmarked implement fail-open.
narratives.NonGoals: Prompt NLP; unmarked generalPurpose without markers; push/merge under assist; #3246 timeout class.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: AC1-AC8 from issue #3259 body (D1 A+B approved as defaults).

narrative.Acceptance: Given DEFT_HOOK_ASSIST=1 or DEFT_SESSION_POSTURE in the assist set and no implement envelope signals, when a Task spawn is classified, the engine returns spawn-ephemeral-ready without requiring xbrief/active.
Given no session assist env and no structural ephemeral worker_role, when a generalPurpose Task spawn runs without active xBRIEF, the engine returns spawn-not-ready.
Given session assist env AND drive-to:merge-ready or implement worker_role in the envelope, when Task spawn is classified without active xBRIEF, spawn is denied (implement wins).
Given structural worker_role or subagent_type in ephemeral|docs|assist, when Task spawn runs without active xBRIEF, spawn-ephemeral-ready still holds.

Given a spawn-not-ready deny, when the operator reads recovery text and commands.md, free-text bracket markers are stated as insufficient and parent Shell or session assist is named as the Cursor local-dev path.
Given the PR, when vitest runs packages/core/src/hooks and CHANGELOG is opened, tests cover AC paths above and [Unreleased] cites #3259.

swarm.missing_traces_justification: Issue body implementation-ready D1 A+B; hooks dispatcher is SoT for spawn gate.
